calls.title: Customer Success Overview for Design Team
calls.summary: The team discussed the expansion of customer success efforts, highlighted by a $2 million contract with Anthropic for enhanced paid support and engineering resources. The small, cross-functional customer success team, led by Cris Dizon, partners with key accounts like Sony and Discord to manage feature requests and engage in regular meetings. Plans for usability sessions and automated surveys were proposed to capture user feedback and insights post-onboarding. Additionally, the importance of understanding customer segmentation and operating models was emphasized, as centralized and autonomous teams impact support needs. Collaboration between design and customer success was also addressed, with proposals to share onboarding recordings and integrate design into customer interactions for better alignment.
calls.keywords: Customer Success, Experimentation Programs, Onboarding, Usability Feedback, Design Integration, Customer Surveys
